title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Desk Reference Card — Settling an Approved Invoice Dispute
content:
An invoice dispute that Commercial Credit has resolved in the business's favor is settled by one dispute credit against the disputed invoice; a dispute credit posts only when the invoice dispute request has status approved, and it references the disputed invoice and the request.

## What the settlement governs

On a Ridgeline Pro Credit account, the settlement of an approved invoice dispute is a single dispute credit line. It is booked against the invoice the dispute request names, carries that request's reference, and credits the dispute settlement credit owed on that dispute. The credit lowers what the business owes and shows in the account's activity beside the invoice. An invoice dispute request that is not approved carries no dispute credit, and one invoice receives at most one dispute credit.

## Booking the credit

The dispute credit is booked by the agent with the task tool `post_dispute_credit_3cc5c337`. It is a hidden tool: the agent first unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Capability.** One call books one dispute credit line on a Ridgeline Pro Credit account against the disputed invoice, carrying that invoice's number and the reference of the invoice dispute request it settles, dated today and placed in today's statement period, and lowers the account's current balance by the credited amount.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trade_account_id` | The reference number of the Ridgeline Pro Credit account the disputed invoice was charged to, as returned by the Pro Credit account lookup | Identifier |
| `original_transaction_id` | The reference number of the disputed invoice line itself, as returned by the Pro Credit activity lookup — the invoice line the dispute request names | Identifier |
| `trade_request_id` | The reference number of the invoice dispute request this credit settles, as returned by the Pro Credit service request lookup | Identifier |
| `credit_amount` | The amount credited to the business | USD, a positive number rounded to 2 decimal places; booked exactly as given |

### Return

On success the tool returns a confirmation with `status` "posted", `trade_transaction_id` (the reference number of the new dispute credit line), `invoice_number` (the invoice credited, exactly as printed), `credit_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `transaction_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and `current_balance` (the account balance after the credit, USD, 2 decimal places). The tool's contract defines no other outcome.

### Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with `trade_account_id` "TA-EXAMPLE", `original_transaction_id` "TX-INVOICE-EXAMPLE", `trade_request_id` "TR-EXAMPLE" and `credit_amount` 100.00 returns `status` "posted" with the new line's reference, the invoice number of the invoice line and the balance lowered by 100.00.
